name: Kiefer
source:
Leader of the Hiei Knight Troupe, he's an aide to [url=/c43962]Levias[/url] along with [url=/c43956]Kain[/url].
A prideful guy that comes from a very aristocratic family.
He's a sadist that enjoys meting out cruel punishments.
He has a great hatred for his family that ostracized him when he was growing up.
